description.en: A follow-up changes the direction; all-origin and China-origin reports remain separate.
description.zh: 同一对话中换方向，也能分别查看全部来源与中国来源。

limitations.en: A real run on a seen scenario. The model selected tools; figures and public summaries are program-generated, not a general accuracy claim.
limitations.zh: 已见场景的真实运行；模型选工具，数字和公开摘要由程序生成，不代表总体准确率。

description.en: The everyday name resolves to 1507, with twelve months of import values.
description.zh: 日常名称命中1507，查看十二个月的豆油进口。

limitations.en: One independent development check, not proof that all everyday names resolve correctly.
limitations.zh: 一次独立开发检查，不代表所有商品名称都能自动识别。

title.en: Soybean oil is not raw soybeans

description.en: An archived notice alongside import values and China-origin shares for five product codes.
description.zh: 五类商品分别展示公告背景、进口金额和中国来源份额。

limitations.en: An edited archival report, not a policy answer generated by the current Agent. It gives neither current total duties nor causal effects.
limitations.zh: 存档资料编辑稿，不是当前Agent生成的政策回答；不表示现行综合税率，也没有因果结论。

title.zh: 钨和光伏材料：政策与进口

description.en: The latest available month cannot silently replace the month requested.
description.zh: 不能把“上个月”偷偷改成“最新可用月”。

limitations.en: Clock fixed at 29 September 2026. The model tried July instead; the program blocked it. No report was generated, and the model's month choice was not correct.
limitations.zh: 固定2026-09-29时钟。模型曾改查7月，程序拦截；没有生成报告，不算模型答对。
